name: Dig it [👽 EVENT]
desc:
Go digging for rare treasure to sell as you explore this wacky, wide world full of NPC characters and become rich with your upgrades! Discover new areas with MORE loot, complete & level up from quests, and get free boosts while you play!

Accessible on PC, Console, Mobile & Tablet!
